newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Indonesia Sierad unit closes $50 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Sierad unit closes $50 mln loan.

text.p: Indonesia poultry feed producer PT Sierad Feedmill, a unit of Sierad Produce, has completed a three-year US$50 million term loan facility, the arrangers said.

The loan, guaranteed by PT Anwar Sierad and PT Sierad Produce, pays a margin of 157.5 basis points over the Singapore Interbank Offered Rate to direct tax-absorbed lenders or 112.5 basis points over SIBOR to stand-by letter of credit lenders.
Fees are 27 basis points for lead managers, 23 basis points for senior managers and 19 basis points for managers. There is a commitment fee of 25 basis points.
Arrangers are Rabobank's Singapore branch and PT Rabobank Duta Indonesia, with US$3 million each, and Sanwa Bank's Singapore branch, with US$8 million.
Co-arrangers, with US$6 million each, are Commerzbank's Singapore branch, Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank's Singapore branch and Development Bank of Singapore.
Senior managers, with US$5 million each, are Fuji Bank's Singapore branch and Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation.
Managers are BHF-BANK's Singapore branch and Tat Lee Bank, with US$3 million each, and Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan's Singapore branch.
